title: German Shiro Frittata
description: A German-inspired twist on the Italian classic, using Ethiopian shiro for added depth of flavor.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the Herbes de Provence and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Shiro and cook for 2 minutes, until lightly browned.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Crack in the eggs and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with De Provence Salt and Black Pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Herbes de Provence if desired.
